properties.name: Black Creek / Black River entrance
properties.source: noaa_chart_review: NOAA labels it Black Creek; OpenStreetMap labels the same waterway Black River (cross-checked 2026-07-27)
properties.evidence: Labeled "Black Creek" on the NOAA nautical chart (ENC/NCDS) narrowing from open water into a defined creek channel northeast of Jolly Bay; the same waterway is tagged "Black River" in OpenStreetMap. Two independent sources disagree on the name, not on the location.
properties.uncertainty: Point placed at the approximate charted narrows/entrance read from a rendered WMS tile; not a surveyed position. Actual usable channel position and depth require on-water review. Correction (2026-07-29): original point sat well within the forest ~250m from the river, not water; moved into the river channel per satellite imagery review.
properties.source_reference: NOAA Chart Display Service (NCDS) WMS (gis.charttools.noaa.gov, MCS/NOAAChartDisplay), sublayers 0-12, reviewed 2026-07-27; name discrepancy cross-checked against OpenStreetMap tile.openstreetmap.org rendering, 2026-07-27

properties.name: Choctawhatchee River — South Mouth
properties.source: noaa_chart_review: NOAA Chart Display Service (NCDS) WMS (gis.charttools.noaa.gov, MCS/NOAAChartDisplay), sublayers 0-12, reviewed 2026-07-27
properties.evidence: Charted and labeled "South Mouth" of the Choctawhatchee River (NOAA ENC/NCDS), a distributary mouth of the Choctawhatchee River south of Jolly Bay near Bunker Cove and Bells Leg.
properties.uncertainty: Point placed at the approximate charted label position read from a rendered WMS tile; not a surveyed position. This is the southern distributary mouth, not the main Choctawhatchee River mouth near Freeport.
properties.source_reference: NOAA Chart Display Service (NCDS) WMS (gis.charttools.noaa.gov, MCS/NOAAChartDisplay), sublayers 0-12, reviewed 2026-07-27

properties.name: ICW gateway (Jolly Bay complex to Choctawhatchee Bay)
properties.source: noaa_chart_review: NOAA Chart Display Service (NCDS) WMS (gis.charttools.noaa.gov, MCS/NOAAChartDisplay), sublayers 0-12, reviewed 2026-07-27
properties.evidence: Approximate transition point where the Jolly Bay/Choctawhatchee River delta complex opens into Choctawhatchee Bay and the marked Gulf Intracoastal Waterway (GIWW) mainline; nearest charted GIWW aids to the west include green daybeacon "C 15" and red nun "16" (approx. 30.392, -86.148).
properties.uncertainty: This is a general gateway/transition area, not a single charted point — placed at the charted "Foul" ground boundary nearest the river complex. Not a substitute for the actual numbered ICW aids when transiting.
properties.source_reference: NOAA Chart Display Service (NCDS) WMS (gis.charttools.noaa.gov, MCS/NOAAChartDisplay), sublayers 0-12, reviewed 2026-07-27

properties.name: Mitchell River entrance
properties.source: noaa_chart_review: NOAA Chart Display Service (NCDS) WMS (gis.charttools.noaa.gov, MCS/NOAAChartDisplay), sublayers 0-12, reviewed 2026-07-27
properties.evidence: Charted and labeled "Mitchell River" (NOAA ENC/NCDS), a distinct river channel entering the Jolly Bay marsh complex just east of the existing pilot area.
properties.uncertainty: Point placed at the approximate charted narrows/entrance read from a rendered WMS tile; not a surveyed position. Correction (2026-07-29): original point sat deep in the marsh island, not water; moved into the visible river channel per satellite imagery review.
properties.source_reference: NOAA Chart Display Service (NCDS) WMS (gis.charttools.noaa.gov, MCS/NOAAChartDisplay), sublayers 0-12, reviewed 2026-07-27
